label: copy-phase input v (mid/late recall), strongest before x
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during the original tokens or at <DEL>), and almost always on a step whose input is a token already seen. 77% of activation mass falls on steps where the fed-back input is v (rate 9.4% vs 0.4% base). Activity peaks at recall_idx 3-5 and is near zero at recall_idx 0-1. Magnitude is largest when v is followed by x, i.e. the model is outputting x: v & out_tok==x has precision 0.73, and every top example is ...v x... in the middle of the sequence. Weaker activations land on x, n, 1 and m inputs, and on tokens just before an upcoming x. The feature does NOT fire on most copy-phase v inputs (precision only ~0.3), especially at early recall positions or where no x follows. A conjunction with an x-follow condition gets precision 0.83 but recall only 13%, so the description is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=17: v, n, x, 1; t=12: v, x, n, 1; t=15: v, x, n, 1) and the token being output (most: x, 1, n, l, v, h; least: g, k, b, j); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=13.
